definition: The reasoning enumerates a set of concrete system-state conditions to be confirmed (an audit checklist) before the task may be declared complete.
parameters: [{name: reasoning, type: reasoning, description: ...}]
assertion_conditions: reasoning lists two or more distinct state conditions/artifacts to be checked; the list is framed as a checklist for verification rather than as actions to change the system.
exclusion: reasoning only states a single check; reasoning states steps that modify the system rather than verify it; reasoning merely restates previously observed results without enumerating conditions to confirm.

definition: An action collects current state for the specific conditions enumerated in a prior verification plan, and its result reports values for those conditions, enabling the plan's criteria to be checked.
assertion: plan_reasoning enumerates criteria to check; audit_action queries the state corresponding to those criteria (possibly several in one invocation); audit_result contains the corresponding values/artifacts.
exclusion: action probes something not in the plan; result lacks evidence for the planned criteria; no prior criteria enumerated.

definition: The reasoning specifies that the check must reproduce the exact usage sequence stipulated by the requester, and the action executes that sequence so a pass demonstrates the stipulated workflow works.
assertion: reasoning explicitly commits to running the requester's own documented commands/flow (not an internal proxy); action performs that sequence.
exclusion: action uses an alternative or partial implementation of the flow; reasoning only describes expected behavior without committing to replay.

name: CONFIRMS_REQUIREMENT_SATISFACTION

definition: The reasoning concludes that a stipulated acceptance requirement is satisfied because the observation exhibits exactly the behavior the requirement demands.
assertion: reasoning asserts requirement met; observation shows the stipulated end behavior (value/output/status) matching.
exclusion: reasoning merely notes the command ran without asserting requirement satisfaction; observation shows a different or partial behavior.

assertion: reasoning identifies a specific property of the probe technique (tool option, capability, encoding, recursion setting) that would produce the observed result independently of the target system; and it points to independent evidence that the target state is otherwise as expected (optional, could be in conditions).
exclusion: reasoning treats result as genuine evidence about the system; no methodological cause identified.

assertion: reasoning names the anomaly; asserts no impact on required behavior; cites functional evidence (successful login, successful service response) rather than ignoring it.
exclusion: reasoning dismisses the anomaly without explanation or evidence; reasoning treats it as a blocking problem; anomaly affects required function.

exclusion: observation already states status in plain terms; reasoning restates raw content without mapping.

assertion: reasoning expresses doubt/inconclusiveness about a result; action addresses the same question via alternative means.
exclusion: action explores a new question; no doubt expressed.

candidate_predicates.name: IS_STATE_AUDIT_PLAN
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning enumerates a set of distinct, concrete system-state conditions that must be confirmed before the task may be declared complete, functioning as a verification checklist rather than as a list of changes to make.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text enumerating the state conditions to be confirmed.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning lists two or more distinct conditions, artifacts, or behaviors to be checked in the current system state.
The listed items are framed as things to confirm or observe, not as actions that modify the system.
At least one item includes an anticipated or acceptance value against which a later observation can be compared.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning describes a single check without forming a multi-item verification set.
The reasoning lists only modification steps (install, write, configure) with no confirmation criteria.
The reasoning merely restates results already observed without enumerating conditions still to be confirmed.

candidate_predicates.name: AUDITS_PLANNED_CRITERIA
candidate_predicates.definition: An action collects current state for the specific conditions enumerated in a prior verification plan, and its result reports values or artifacts for those conditions, so that each planned criterion can be checked against the returned state.

parameters.name: plan_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning enumerating the criteria to be verified.

parameters.name: audit_action
parameters.description: The action that gathers the corresponding system state, possibly several checks in one invocation.

parameters.name: audit_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the values or artifacts for the planned criteria.

assertion_conditions: The plan_reasoning enumerates specific conditions to be confirmed.
The audit_action inspects the aspects of the system that correspond to those conditions.
The audit_result contains identifiable values for the planned criteria, sufficient to judge each one.
exclusion_conditions: The action probes aspects unrelated to the enumerated criteria.
The observation does not report values for the planned criteria.
No prior criteria were enumerated, so the action is exploratory rather than an audit of a plan.

candidate_predicates.name: REPLAYS_STIPULATED_USAGE_AS_ACCEPTANCE_TEST
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning commits to reproducing the exact usage sequence or commands stipulated by the requester, and the action executes that sequence so that a pass demonstrates the stipulated workflow itself works.

parameters.name: test_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating that the requester's own documented sequence will be reproduced as the test.

parameters.name: replay_action
parameters.description: The action executing that stipulated sequence.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly states that the check will mirror the requester's own documented commands or workflow.
The action performs that sequence rather than an internal proxy or a reduced subset.
exclusion_conditions: The action tests an alternative or partial implementation of the workflow instead of the stipulated one.
The reasoning only describes expected behavior without committing to replaying the requester's sequence.
The action exercises components individually in a way the requester would not.

candidate_predicates.name: CONFIRMS_REQUIREMENT_SATISFACTION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning concludes that a stipulated acceptance requirement is satisfied because the observation exhibits exactly the behavior that requirement demands.

parameters.name: conclusion_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text asserting that the acceptance requirement is met.

parameters.name: result_observation
parameters.description: The observation exhibiting the stipulated end behavior.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning asserts that a previously stated acceptance requirement or desired end behavior is met.
The observation reports the stipulated behavior itself (expected content, status, or result) rather than an intermediate side effect.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports that a command executed without asserting requirement satisfaction.
The observation shows a different, partial, or unexpected behavior.
The reasoning asserts success before the corresponding observation exists.

candidate_predicates.name: EXPLAINS_RESULT_AS_PROBE_ARTIFACT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning attributes an unexpected, empty, or negative result to a limitation or behavior of the measurement technique itself, rather than to the state of the system being inspected.

parameters.name: diagnostic_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text identifying the methodological cause of the unexpected result.

parameters.name: anomalous_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the unexpected, empty, or misleading result.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific property of the probe method (tool option, missing capability, encoding, non-recursion, buffering) that would produce the observed result regardless of the target state.
The reasoning contrasts this methodological explanation with independent evidence that the target state is actually as intended.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning treats the unexpected result as genuine evidence about the target system.
No methodological cause for the result is identified.
The reasoning merely repeats the null result without explaining it.

candidate_predicates.name: ASSESSES_ANOMALY_AS_NON_IMPACTING
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning acknowledges that an anomaly reported in the observation is real but judges it inconsequential to the required functionality, grounding that judgment in independent evidence that the required function still succeeds.

parameters.name: assessment_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text evaluating the significance of the observed anomaly.

parameters.name: anomaly_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the anomaly (unexpected process state, leftover connection state, stray artifacts).

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names the observed anomaly and states explicitly that it does not affect the required behavior.
The judgment is supported by independent functional evidence (a successful operation that exercises the same subsystem) rather than by assertion alone.
exclusion_conditions: The anomaly is dismissed without any explanation or supporting functional evidence.
The reasoning treats the anomaly as a blocking problem that must be eliminated.
The anomaly actually prevents or degrades the required functionality.

candidate_predicates.name: DECODES_ENCODED_OBSERVATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning translates low-level or encoded fields returned by an observation (numeric state codes, hexadecimal addresses, raw tables, machine-oriented formats) into domain-level states, and the stated conclusion depends on that translation.

parameters.name: interpretation_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text mapping raw fields to domain-level meanings.

parameters.name: encoded_observation
parameters.description: The observation whose content is in an encoded or machine-oriented form.

assertion_conditions: The observation content is not stated in plain domain terms (codes, hex, tabular raw fields).
The reasoning explicitly maps the encoded values to concrete domain states and derives its conclusion from that mapping.
exclusion_conditions: The observation already reports the state in plain semantic terms.
The reasoning restates raw content without mapping it to domain meanings.
The reasoning's conclusion does not depend on the decoded fields.

candidate_predicates.name: REINVESTIGATES_SUSPECT_RESULT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning flags a check as inconclusive, empty, or suspicious, and the action re-examines the same underlying question using a different technique or source of evidence.

parameters.name: doubt_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text expressing doubt about a prior or current result and the need to re-check.

parameters.name: recheck_action
parameters.description: The action that re-examines the same question by alternative means.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning expresses doubt, inconclusiveness, or suspicion about an existing result.
The action addresses the same underlying question, using a different method, source, or tool than the earlier attempt.
exclusion_conditions: The action investigates a new question rather than the doubted result.
No doubt or inconclusiveness about an existing result is expressed.
The action simply repeats the identical probe that already produced the suspect result without changing technique.

candidate_predicates.name: RESTORES_BASELINE_STATE
candidate_predicates.definition: The action removes or reverts artifacts created during testing so the system returns to its pre-test condition, and the reasoning states that the purpose is to leave a pristine starting point for the requester's own use.

parameters.name: restore_action
parameters.description: The action deleting or reverting test-created artifacts.

parameters.name: restore_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text stating the intent to return the system to its initial state.

assertion_conditions: The action deletes, empties, or reverts state that was produced by the agent's own testing.
The reasoning states that the goal is a clean/initial state so the requester's intended flow will work without interference.
exclusion_conditions: The action modifies state for a purpose other than reverting to the pre-test condition.
The reasoning only notes that cleanup finished without stating the pristine-state intent.
The action removes artifacts but leaves the system in a state that still blocks the requester's flow.

candidate_predicates.name: IMPLEMENTS_PREVENTIVE_SAFEGUARD
candidate_predicates.definition: In response to reasoning that a required capability may later become unavailable, the action installs an additive fallback or auto-recovery mechanism that restores the capability without user intervention, beyond the minimum needed for the task.

parameters.name: anticipation_reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text identifying a possible future failure of a required capability.

parameters.name: safeguard_action
parameters.description: The action creating the fallback or recovery mechanism.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a possible future failure or restart scenario for a required capability.
The action creates a mechanism whose purpose is to re-establish or preserve that capability automatically, rather than performing the capability once.
The mechanism is added robustness that exceeds the minimum required configuration.
exclusion_conditions: The action directly performs the required operation instead of preparing a recovery mechanism.
No possible future failure or restart scenario is expressed in the reasoning.
The action only documents or reports the capability without enabling its recovery.

candidate_predicates.name: SUMMARIZES_COMPLETED_TASK
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning consolidates multiple completed and verified results into a completion report and declares that the task is finished.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text presenting the consolidated completion report.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning reports several distinct results that were produced and verified during the run.
The reasoning explicitly declares the task finished or complete.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning is a plan for future actions rather than a report of completed work.
The reasoning covers a single result without consolidating the outcome.
The reasoning leaves the task open or requests further input.
